title: Maths Quiz
description: This is a maths quiz it's give u reward if u solved thease questionz
body: **This plugin adds a fun and simple automatic Maths Quiz system directly into your Minecraft server chat, where at a configurable time interval the server sends an easy maths question such as addition, subtraction, multiplication or small division (for example 5+7, 9−3, 4×2 or 16÷4) to all online players, and the first player who types the correct answer in chat instantly wins a reward, which can be set to either 1 diamond, 1 iron ingot, or 1 oak log, making learning and playing happen at the same time in a friendly and competitive way; the plugin is designed especially for survival and school-friendly servers, keeping all questions short and beginner-level so every player can participate without stress, and it automatically checks answers from normal chat messages without needing any commands, GUIs or special permissions for players, while admins can easily customize the question interval, choose whether rewards rotate randomly between diamond, iron and oak log or stay fixed, enable or disable certain operations like division, and control how many digits are used in each question to keep the difficulty balanced; the plugin also supports simple cooldown handling so only the first correct message is accepted, prevents spam by ignoring wrong answers after the round is finished, broadcasts the winner’s name clearly in chat, and gives the reward directly to the player’s inventory with a safe fallback message if the inventory is full, ensuring smooth gameplay without item loss; because the system runs fully automatically in the background, it encourages quick thinking, basic maths practice and positive competition, making it perfect for small SMP servers, classroom servers, or family servers where you want to add something educational, lightweight and entertaining without affecting performance, complicated setup or existing chat plugins, while still being fully configurable, reliable and easy to manage for server owners who want a simple yet meaningful mini-game inside their server chat.**
